name: CWFID: Crop/Weed Field Image Dataset for Precision Agriculture
description: The Crop/Weed Field Image Dataset (CWFID) is a pioneering precision agriculture computer vision benchmark published alongside research at the ECCV 2014 Computer Vision in Plant Phenotyping and Agriculture workshop. Captured on an organic carrot and sugar beet agricultural plot in Germany, the dataset consists of 60 top-down field images (1296x966 pixels) accompanied by precise pixel-level vegetation segmentation ground-truth masks and point-coordinate annotations distinguishing crop plants from unwanted weeds. CWFID provides an essential evaluation platform for agricultural robotics, robotic weeding, selective herbicide spraying, and spatial vegetation segmentation.
